seo.title: Our Work: Marketing & Website Projects | Helix24
seo.description: Examples of Helix24 projects for retail, healthcare and real estate businesses in Kerala and the GCC: the challenge and what we did.

title: Our
intro: Real problems from businesses like yours, and how their customers now find them and get in touch. Client names are kept private.

items.title: Getting every enquiry to the right branch
items.problem: Enquiries all went to one number, so other branches replied late or not at all.

items.title: Making an online store easy to buy from on a phone
items.problem: Shoppers came from Instagram on their phones, but the store was slow and checkout was long.

items.title: Helping a clinic show up on Google Maps
items.problem: People searching nearby rarely found the clinic, and its ads paid for searches that never booked.

items.title: Selling Kerala homes to Malayalis in the Gulf
items.problem: Portals sent plenty of enquiries, but few serious buyers, and families abroad were hard to reach.
journey: Site visit on their trip home
